skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Identify and distinguish the purpose and conditions for applying factor analysis problems.
Calculate indices and tests in correlation analysis problems and interpret results.
Differentiate between hierarchical and non-hierarchical clustering algorithms and interpret results.
Interpret the meaning of paired correlation coefficients, partial correlation coefficients, and canonical correlation coefficients.
Calculate indices in principal component analysis problems and interpret results.
Apply processes for collecting data, cleaning data, and creating databases to serve research objectives.
Proficiently use SPSS software to perform factor analysis, correspondence analysis, correlation analysis, cluster analysis, and discriminant analysis.
Proficiently use R programming to perform factor analysis, correspondence analysis, correlation analysis, cluster analysis, and discriminant analysis.
Propose research topics, organize task assignments for group members, and develop research plans (design questionnaires, conduct surveys, analyze data, write reports).
Apply factor analysis methods to economic-social models, use software for calculation, analysis, and explanation of model results.
Write reports on results, propose solutions based on research findings.
Demonstrate proficiency in presentation skills before a class audience.
